blog.title: QuoteCraft: client quotes in minutes
blog.description: Make a clean, professional quote with line items, tax, and discount — then print it or save it as a PDF.

body.text: Quotes win work. Slow quotes lose it. QuoteCraft exists so a professional quote takes minutes, not an afternoon.

Type your business name and the client's name. Add line items with quantities and prices. The subtotal, discount, and tax update live as you type. Hit print to get a clean quote document, or save it as a PDF.

items: Anyone tired of rebuilding quotes in a spreadsheet
Fill in your business and client details
Add a line for each item or service
Set discount and tax if they apply
Print, save as PDF, or store the quote in your browser

body.text: QuoteCraft is $15 a month, or $75 for six months. Pay the admin, request your unlock PIN, and the tool opens up for your whole subscription.
